title: Local finite presentation comparison maps
statement: Let X be a ringed space, F a finitely presented module, and psi: O_X^r -> F an epimorphism. For each point x there is a neighborhood U, a finite presentation P of F restricted to U, a map psi-prime from O_U^r to F restricted to U, and comparison maps alpha and beta satisfying alpha followed by P.generators.pi = psi-prime and beta followed by psi-prime = P.generators.pi. The restriction of kernel psi is isomorphic to kernel psi-prime.

source.place: Modules, Lemma 01BP(1), proof first paragraph; kernels: Section 01AF

proof.text: Choose a presentation around x from the local finite presentation data. Since its generator map and psi are epis, local lifting supplies lifts of each of the finitely many basis images in both directions. Intersect their neighborhoods containing x.

Restrict the presentation to the intersection; restriction preserves finite free modules, kernels, and epis. Transport the restricted psi across the canonical free-module isomorphism to obtain psi-prime. Define alpha and beta from the chosen lifts. Their equations hold on bases and hence as module morphisms. Sectionwise kernels identify the restricted kernel with kernel psi-prime.
